title: Tool commands
description: The commands a contributor or CI runs from the repository root.

entities.name: Check the specification material
entities.description: Runs the eight structural checks in order and prints ok or FAIL for each.
entities.transport: command line: python3 tools/validate.py, from the repository root
entities.result: Exit code 0 and "All structural checks passed.", or exit code 1 with the number of failures; each failure is printed as it is found.
failures: A schema in schema/ is not a valid Draft 2020-12 schema: check_schema raises and the script stops with a traceback.
A JSON file has a duplicate key: load_json raises ValueError and the script stops.
A value in valid.json is rejected, or does not carry the wire identifier utv/1.0.
A value in invalid-structural.json is accepted.
A complete UTV example embedded in spec/*.md is rejected.
A scenario is missing a required field or repeats an id; a falsehood id is in the matrix and not in falsehoods.json, or the other way round.
An everyday fixture names a rule bundle that does not exist, repeats an id, or holds a UTV value the schema rejects.
A text-form fixture repeats an id or holds a value the schema rejects.

entities.name: Regenerate the side-by-side page
entities.description: Collects the code between BEGIN and END markers in the five UTV-first suites and writes docs/side-by-side.md.
entities.result: docs/side-by-side.md is rewritten, task by task in the order of SECTIONS, with each language's marked code; tasks a language has not marked are listed under a final Missing heading.
failures: A BEGIN marker opens inside another task's block, an END names a task other than the open one, or a BEGIN is never closed: the script exits with the file and the marker.

entities.name: Check the side-by-side page is current
entities.description: Renders the page in memory and compares it with docs/side-by-side.md.
entities.result: Exit code 0 when the page matches what the tests would produce.
failures: The page differs: exit code 1 and "docs/side-by-side.md is out of date; run python3 tools/side_by_side.py".
The same marker errors as when writing the page.

relatedViews.relationship: The use cases that run them.
